topics.name: Game Loop Timer
topics.concept: Game loops update simulation and render frames, with fixed timesteps keeping physics deterministic across hardware. The timer implements variable and fixed-step loops measuring spiral-of-death protection. Every game runs on this heartbeat.
topics.data_idea: Frame timings derive from simulated workloads.

topics.name: Sprite Animation Controller
topics.concept: Sprite animation cycles frames with timing, transitions, and blending between states. The controller plays clips with frame durations and state machines. Characters come alive.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives state changes.

topics.name: Tilemap Renderer
topics.concept: Tilemaps build worlds from reusable tiles with layers and culling for performance. The renderer draws visible tiles from ASCII or index maps. Retro worlds, efficient rendering.

topics.name: AABB Collision Detector
topics.concept: Axis-aligned bounding boxes give cheap overlap tests, the first pass of collision detection. The detector checks box intersections with swept variants for fast movers. Broadphase before narrowphase.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG moves boxes with collisions.

topics.name: Spatial Hash Grid
topics.concept: Spatial hashing buckets entities into grid cells so collision checks only test neighbors. The grid inserts and queries with cell sizing tradeoffs. O(n) neighbor queries for crowds.
topics.real_world_use: Used in particle and crowd sims.

topics.name: Quadtree Collider
topics.concept: Quadtrees recursively subdivide space so sparse regions stay cheap and dense regions get detail. The collider builds the tree querying potential collisions. Adaptive spatial indexing.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG clusters entities unevenly.
topics.real_world_use: Used in 2D games with varied density.

topics.name: A-Star Pathfinder Game
topics.concept: Game units pathfind on grids with A-star, smoothing paths and avoiding dynamic obstacles. The tool animates open and closed sets with path string-pulling. RTS movement in a box.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG places obstacles and goals.

topics.name: Steering Behaviors
topics.concept: Steering combines seek, flee, arrive, and avoidance forces into lifelike movement. The simulator blends behaviors with weights showing emergent motion. Autonomy from simple rules.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG steers agents to goals.

topics.name: Boids Flocking
topics.concept: Three rules, separation, alignment, cohesion, produce flocking birds and schooling fish. The simulator tunes rule weights showing phase transitions. Emergence from simplicity.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG initializes boid velocities.

topics.name: Projectile Physics
topics.concept: Projectiles fly with gravity, drag, and bounces, needing integration stable at game framerates. The simulator compares Euler and Verlet integration. Angry trajectories, computed right.
topics.real_world_use: Used in artillery and sports games.

topics.name: Particle System
topics.concept: Particles fake fire, smoke, and sparks with hundreds of short-lived sprites. The system spawns, updates, and renders particles with emitters. Juice for every explosion.

topics.name: Screen Shake Controller
topics.concept: Screen shake sells impacts with trauma-based decay, avoiding motion sickness. The controller applies rotational and translational noise scaled by trauma. Feel the hit.

topics.name: Damage Number Popups
topics.concept: Floating damage numbers give combat feedback with crit styling and stacking. The system spawns, animates, and pools popup labels. Numbers go up, dopamine follows.

topics.name: Health Damage System
topics.concept: Health systems apply damage with armor, resistances, and invulnerability frames. The system computes mitigated damage with death events. Combat math, centralized.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG deals damage types.

topics.name: Inventory System
topics.concept: Inventories manage items with stacking, equipment slots, and weight limits. The system handles add, remove, and equip with capacity rules. Loot finds a home.

topics.name: Loot Drop Tables
topics.concept: Drop tables turn kill rewards into weighted random tables with rarity tiers and pity timers. The designer simulates drops verifying rates. Fair randomness, tuned.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG rolls loot drops.

topics.name: XP Level Curve
topics.concept: Level curves map cumulative XP to levels with pacing that feels rewarding. The designer plots curves tuning time-to-level. Progression, graphed.
topics.data_idea: XP income derives from gameplay rates.

topics.name: Skill Tree
topics.concept: Skill trees gate abilities behind prerequisites with point budgets. The system validates allocations and computes build stats. Choices matter.

topics.name: Quest Tracker
topics.concept: Quests chain objectives with branching and completion tracking. The tracker manages active quests with objective states. Adventure stays organized.

topics.name: Dialogue Tree Engine
topics.concept: Dialogue trees branch conversations with conditions and memory of past choices. The engine traverses nodes evaluating flags. Stories branch.

topics.name: NPC Schedule Sim
topics.concept: Believable NPCs follow daily schedules: work, eat, sleep, with reactions to disruptions. The simulator runs schedules with needs and interruptions. Worlds feel alive.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives days with events.

topics.name: Day Night Cycle
topics.concept: Day-night cycles drive lighting, NPC behavior, and gameplay with smooth transitions. The system advances time scaling with events at thresholds. Time passes visibly.

topics.name: Weather System
topics.concept: Weather affects visibility, movement, and mood with transitioning states. The system blends conditions with gameplay modifiers. Storms change plans.

topics.name: Save Load Manager
topics.concept: Saves serialize game state with versioning for backward compatibility. The manager snapshots, versions, and migrates saves. Progress persists.
topics.data_idea: Game states derive from play sessions.

topics.name: Checkpoint System
topics.concept: Checkpoints save progress at milestones with respawn state. The system records checkpoints restoring on death. Failure stings less.

topics.name: Input Remapper
topics.concept: Remappable controls let players customize bindings with conflict detection. The remapper maps actions to inputs validating overlaps. Accessibility and preference.

topics.name: Combo Detector
topics.concept: Fighting games detect input sequences within timing windows for special moves. The detector matches buffered inputs against move lists. Skill gets recognized.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG presses buttons with combos.

topics.name: Cooldown Manager
topics.concept: Ability cooldowns gate powerful actions with visual timers and charge systems. The manager tracks per-ability readiness. Power gets paced.

topics.name: Status Effects Engine
topics.concept: Poison, burn, and stun tick over time with stacking rules and cleanses. The engine applies effect instances with durations. Battles gain texture.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG applies effects in combat.

topics.name: Turn Based Battle Engine
topics.concept: Turn-based combat orders actions by speed with menus and animations. The engine runs rounds with AI opponents. Strategy over reflexes.

topics.name: Card Deck Shuffler
topics.concept: Card games need fair shuffles and hand evaluation, from Fisher-Yates to poker ranks. The shuffler deals with verifiable randomness. Luck, fairly distributed.

topics.name: Dice Roller
topics.concept: Dice with advantage, exploding dice, and modifiers power tabletop mechanics. The roller parses notation like 4d6kh3. Probability, dramatized.

topics.name: Roguelike Dungeon Generator
topics.concept: Procedural dungeons carve rooms and corridors with connectivity guarantees. The generator places rooms, connects them, and populates encounters. Infinite replayability.

topics.name: Wave Spawner
topics.concept: Wave spawners escalate enemy counts and composition keeping tension. The spawner schedules waves with budgets and breaks. Survival gets structured.
topics.real_world_use: Used in tower defense and horde modes.

topics.name: Tower Defense Pathing
topics.concept: Enemies follow paths that towers attack in range, with pathing updates when players build. The simulator routes waves with tower DPS. Mazes meet firepower.

topics.name: Hitstop Controller
topics.concept: Hitstop freezes frames on impact for punch, a staple of game feel. The controller pauses simulation briefly scaling with damage. Impact gets weight.

topics.name: Replay Recorder
topics.concept: Replays record inputs deterministically for playback and highlights. The recorder captures input streams with checksums. Epic moments, relived.
topics.real_world_use: Used in fighting and racing games.

topics.name: Leaderboard Manager
topics.concept: Leaderboards rank scores with seasons and anti-cheat sanity checks. The manager maintains rankings with percentile bands. Competition, quantified.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG submits scores with cheaters.
